THEWILDFIRE-FIREPOWER.title: Firepower
THEWILDFIRE-FIREPOWER.description: The fire raging within. When you end your turn with [blue]10[/blue] or more Firepower, you [gold]Overheat[/gold] and lose [blue]1[/blue] HP for every [blue]10[/blue] [gold]Firepower[/gold] you have.
THEWILDFIRE-EXERT.title: Exert
THEWILDFIRE-EXERT.description: Spend up to [blue]{Exert}[/blue] [gold]Firepower[/gold] when this card is played.
THEWILDFIRE-EXERT-X.title: Exert
THEWILDFIRE-EXERT-X.description: Spend ALL [gold]Firepower[/gold] when this card is played.
THEWILDFIRE-IGNITE.title: Ignite
THEWILDFIRE-IGNITE_STATIC.title: Ignite
THEWILDFIRE-FLARE.title: Flare
THEWILDFIRE-FLARE.description: Can only be played if you have [blue]{Flare}[/blue] [gold]Firepower[/gold]. Set your [gold]Firepower[/gold] to [blue]0[/blue] after playing.
THEWILDFIRE-FLARE_STATIC.title: Flare
THEWILDFIRE-FLARE_STATIC.description: Can only be played if you have sufficient [gold]Firepower[/gold]. Set your [gold]Firepower[/gold] to [blue]0[/blue] after playing.
THEWILDFIRE-EXERT_STATIC.title: Exert
THEWILDFIRE-EXERT_STATIC.description: This card spends [gold]Firepower[/gold] up to its [gold]Exert[/gold] value when played.
THEWILDFIRE-OVERHEAT.title: Overheat
THEWILDFIRE-OVERHEAT.description: When you Overheat, you lose [blue]1[/blue] HP for every [blue]10[/blue] [gold]Firepower[/gold] you have.
